transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I decided to come in because I'm being followed and monitored by a certain organization, and I don't know who else to turn to. They are watching my every move, and I'm really worried about what they are planning to do to me.

Besides feeling watched, have you experienced any significant periods where your mood felt extremely elevated or unusually energetic, or conversely, periods where you felt deeply depressed or hopeless?

No, I haven't really experienced any extreme shifts in my mood or energy like that. My main concern is just the constant stress of being watched and followed by this group. I generally feel normal otherwise, just very anxious about what they are planning.

Beyond the belief that you are being watched, have you noticed any other unusual experiences, such as hearing voices that others cannot hear or feeling like your thoughts are being controlled or broadcasted to others?

No, I don't hear any voices like that at all. I also don't feel like anyone is controlling my thoughts or broadcasting them to other people. My thoughts are entirely my own, it's just my physical movements that they are monitoring.
How long have you felt that this organization has been monitoring you, and has this belief caused any significant problems in your ability to work or maintain your daily personal relationships?

It has been going on for about 11 months now. Even though it is incredibly stressful and I have to take daily precautions, it hasn't really stopped me from doing my job or keeping up with my friends and family. I'm still able to function normally otherwise, despite the constant worry.

The patient denies functional impairment, but the duration and specific nature of the belief strongly point to Delusional Disorder. I have kept the candidate list the same as it remains the most consistent fit.
